visual_base.visual_narrative_log: (1) The video opens with a low-angle shot of a Costco Wholesale storefront under a bright sky, transitioning to a series of interior shots of a menu board featuring burgers, pies, and hot dogs. The lighting is bright and industrial, characteristic of a large warehouse retail environment. (2) A close-up shows a large pepperoni pizza on a warming shelf before a hand interacts with a digital ordering kiosk, selecting various food items including a chicken burger and bubble tea. The character's hands are clearly visible against the illuminated screen of the interface. (3) A young man with glasses sits at a red table, holding and eating a large fried chicken burger; a detailed insert shot reveals the layered textures of the bun, lettuce, and breaded chicken. The background shows blurred movements of other customers in a typical food court setting. (4) He drinks from a paper cup with a straw and displays a single dark tapioca pearl in his palm for a close-up detail. Next, he bites into a long hot dog that significantly exceeds the length of the bun, followed by a savory pie filled with chunks of beef. (5) In the final segment, he samples a large slice of pepperoni pizza and a chocolate chip cookie, reacting with exaggerated facial expressions to the sweetness. Staff members in hairnets and safety vests are seen prepping food and cleaning tables in the background.

audio_base.audio_narrative_log: (1) The audio features a high-energy male narrator speaking in Mandarin over a bright, synthesized pop BGM track with a steady electronic beat. Subtle ambient room tone from a large retail space is audible beneath the voice. (2) Throughout the video, digital 'selection' pings and subtle chime SFX are synchronized with on-screen text overlays and kiosk interactions. The narrator's speech rate is fast and rhythmic, matching the upbeat tempo of the background music. (3) As the narrator describes the food, the vocal tone shifts to be more expressive and evaluative. Occasional muffled sounds of kitchen activity or rustling paper are captured in the field recording, adding to the authenticity of the food court environment. (4) The track maintains a consistent energy level until the very end, where the narrator asks a concluding question and the BGM reaches a final cadence before cutting out cleanly at the end of the shot.
